tool_args.rationale: The pilot shows only short-window positive gain. A slow-horizon probe can distinguish sustained gain from endogenous reversal and help identify the slow timescale, including the sink-coupled alternative.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five short-horizon observations do not identify the slow response reliably at the target horizon of 23.
Additional fine-scale trajectory data are less directly informative about the slow-horizon reversal.
It is irrelevant to distinguishing the candidate mechanisms.
